description: The interior of a cozy corner cafe with wooden tables, coffee cups on the counter, large windows and potted plants

timeDescriptions.Morning: Soft morning sunlight streams through the windows and casts gentle shadows
timeDescriptions.Midday: Bright, clear daylight fills the room through the windows
timeDescriptions.Afternoon: Warm afternoon light slants in and casts long shadows
timeDescriptions.Evening: Golden sunset light glows through the windows alongside warm lamplight
timeDescriptions.Night: It is night, the room is lit by warm indoor lamps and city lights glow beyond the dark windows

description: A riverside park outdoors with trees, green grass, a footpath along the riverbank and a park bench

timeDescriptions.Morning: Early morning with light mist over the river, dew on the grass and soft light
timeDescriptions.Midday: Midday under a blue sky with bright sunlight and a few white clouds
timeDescriptions.Afternoon: Afternoon sun with long shadows stretching across the grass
timeDescriptions.Evening: Sunset with an orange sky and golden light over the water
timeDescriptions.Night: Night time lit by streetlights and moonlight under a starry sky
